title: Audio Device Production Test and Quality Check
seoDescription: Audio Precision production test: APx audio analyzers, APx1701, GRAS 45CC fixture and APx500 automation for electronic and electro-acoustic audio devices.

props.title: Audio Device Production Test and Quality Check
paragraphs: Production test has to keep cost down without giving up quality. Audio Precision provides complete production test and measurement solutions, from analyzer performance to automation in the APx500 software.
The same tools cover electronic audio devices such as power amplifiers, headphone amplifiers, DACs and ADCs, and electro-acoustic devices such as loudspeakers, microphones and headphones.

props.body:
- Sequence mode, with the Navigator and Sequencer, signal paths, measurements and sequence steps
- Variables, auxiliary control, data export and report generation
- Microphone calibration, output level regulation and input equalization
- Limits defined from a Golden Unit (reference device) and an analog generator voltage limit to protect connected devices
- Password-restricted Production Test mode with a simple operator screen, plus sequence logging and statistics
